snippet.title: CRACK - Announcement Trailer | A Game About Cracking An Egg
snippet.description:
In CRACK, you have one job: crack open a giant egg and uncover what’s inside. 

CRACK is a 1-to-4-player adventure about breaking a mysterious egg, unlocking strange new tools and discovering what the lab is hiding. 

Wishlist CRACK on Steam now! 
Link here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4312190/CRACK/

The game releases on October 26th. (So yeah, wishlist it to avoid missing it!)
